findings.title: Report-run API can enqueue duplicate active reports for the same portfolio

severity.rationale: Impact is high for server-side provider/PDF/storage cost amplification, but likelihood is medium because the attacker must be authenticated and own a portfolio; no cross-tenant data access or credential compromise was found.

confidence.rationale: The source-to-sink path is explicit in the checked-in code and existing tests show the UI path has the missing guard while API tests do not exercise one.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

findings.summary: The authenticated report-run API path bypasses the UI active-run idempotency check and calls createAndEnqueue directly. Each call creates a new queued report run and enqueues a Graphile job keyed by the new run id, allowing a normal authenticated user to repeatedly trigger expensive report-generation work for the same owned portfolio.
findings.rootCause: The active-run idempotency invariant is implemented only in the UI server action rather than in the shared report-run creation service or database transaction boundary.

attackPath.summary: Authenticated same-user attacker repeatedly POSTs the same portfolio to enqueue duplicate server-side report jobs.

validation.method: static source trace plus existing test review
validation.summary: Validated as reportable: authenticated API POST reaches createAndEnqueue and per-run-id queueing without the active-run guard.
validation.limitations: Live HTTP reproduction was not run because the local pipeline needs authenticated session, database, Graphile Worker, provider secrets, and report services.

findings.remediation: Move report-run idempotency into the service layer or database transaction used by every creation path. Before creating/enqueueing, check for an existing queued or processing run for the same user and portfolio and either return that run or reject with a conflict. Prefer an atomic control such as a partial unique index, advisory lock, or transaction-safe service method so concurrent API calls cannot race. Add per-user report generation rate limits before public launch.
